lines.text: God tells Ezekiel to take up a lament for Tyre, the city at the gateway to the sea, which calls itself perfect in beauty.
Tyre's builders make its planking from cypress from Senir and its sail from embroidered fine linen from Assyria.
Men of Sidon and Arvad row Tyre's ship, and the elders of Gebal repair its leaks as shipwrights.
God says the north wind will shatter Tyre in the heart of the sea, and its wealth and people will sink.
The sailors and captains will stand on the shore, throw dust on their heads, shave their heads, and wrap themselves in sackcloth.
